_comment: Legends force-included into the Super Season set. Super Season is otherwise built as 'each CURRENT-POOL player's best season', which structurally excludes anyone who retired before the 2026-27 pool — 11 of the shipped 2025-26 set's 23 retro cards had no path in at all. Each entry names the season the card celebrates. Skill rides the fitted BPM bridge for seasons dunksandthrees' EPM archive does not reach (pre-2002); charts come from Basketball-Reference game logs either way. The user accepted that legend cards may run hot against modern competition.
